title: pearl LED string garland
text: pearl LED string garland. This  a very pretty strand of lit pearls, a garland. I was going to use on a very small artificial christmas tree, but it didn't look right.  Even though it didn't work for my original intended use, it will somewhere - very pretty.

product_metadata.title: Rhytsing 36 LEDs White Pearl Glarand Battery Operated Fairy String Lights with Timer Function for Wedding Christmas Party Event Decoration, 14.7FT
features: PEARL WEDDING GARLAND - 36 LED warm white string lights decorated with 2 different sizes of white pearls, the whole light looks like a LED garland which can be use for weddings, anniversary, parties and big events decoration
WATER PROOF LED COPPER WIRE - The light is waterproof except the battery box, for indoor and outdoor use
BUILT-IN TIMER - There is a 3-way switching (ON-TIMER-OFF) on the battery box. When switch to “TIMER”, The light will work 6 hours every day in same period
3xAA BATTERIES ARE REQUIRED - Each set is powered by 3xAA batteries. We suggest use high capacity alkaline batteries. Batteries not included
Dimension - Length of lead wire: 3.28ft, Total length of lights: 14.76ft
